name: Campbell's Well Yes! Sipping Soup Sweet Potato & Carrots
whyItWorks: A smooth, drinkable puree of sweet potatoes, carrots, and coconut milk in a microwavable sipping cup. Dairy-free, seedless, and requires zero spoon or bowl when traveling.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove lid, microwave cup for 1 minute, and sip warm.
